crossRefs.note: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

translations.web: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
translations.bsb: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
translations.kjv: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
translations.asv: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
